SELECT ft.account_id,
       SUM(ft.transaction_amount * fx_rate(ft.transaction_date)) AS total_amount_jpy
FROM Financial_Transactions ft
GROUP BY ft.account_id;

SELECT a.account_id, SUM(ft.transaction_amount) AS total_yen FROM Financial_Transactions ft JOIN Accounts a ON ft.account_id = a.account_id GROUP BY a.account_id;

SELECT c.customer_id,
       c.customer_first_name,
       c.customer_last_name
FROM Customers AS c
JOIN Customers_Cards AS cc ON cc.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN Financial_Transactions AS ft ON ft.card_id = cc.card_id
WHERE ft.transaction_type = 'Payment'
GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_first_name, c.customer_last_name
HAVING SUM(ft.transaction_amount) >= 10000;
SELECT c.customer_first_name, c.customer_last_name FROM Customers c JOIN Accounts a ON c.customer_id = a.customer_id WHERE a.account_name = 'VIP'

WITH customer_spend AS (
    SELECT c.customer_id,
           SUM(ft.transaction_amount) AS total_spent
    FROM Financial_Transactions ft
    JOIN Accounts a ON ft.account_id = a.account_id
    JOIN Customers c ON a.customer_id = c.customer_id
    GROUP BY c.customer_id
)
SELECT customer_id
FROM customer_spend
WHERE total_spent > 5000;

SELECT c.customer_id,
       SUM(ft.transaction_amount * get_usd_to_eur_rate(ft.transaction_date)) AS total_payments_eur
FROM Customers c
JOIN Accounts a ON a.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN Financial_Transactions ft ON ft.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE ft.transaction_type = 'Payment'
  AND ft.transaction_date >= datetime('now', '-90 days')
GROUP BY c.customer_id;

SELECT c.customer_id, SUM(ft.transaction_amount) AS total_payment_amount
FROM Financial_Transactions ft
JOIN Accounts a ON ft.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN Customers c ON a.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE ft.transaction_type = 'Payment'
AND ft.transaction_date >= datetime('now', '-90 days')
GROUP BY c.customer_id

votes.sql:
WITH customer_spending AS (
    SELECT c.customer_id,
           SUM(ft.transaction_amount) AS total_spent
    FROM Financial_Transactions ft
    JOIN Accounts a ON ft.account_id = a.account_id
    JOIN Customers c ON a.customer_id = c.customer_id
    WHERE ft.transaction_date >= '2018-01-01'
      AND ft.transaction_date < '2019-01-01'
    GROUP BY c.customer_id
)
SELECT c.customer_first_name,
       c.customer_last_name,
       c.customer_email
FROM Customers c
JOIN customer_spending cs ON c.customer_id = cs.customer_id
WHERE cs.total_spent > (SELECT AVG(total_spent) FROM customer_spending);

WITH CardSums AS (
    SELECT
        cc.card_id,
        cc.customer_id,
        SUM(ft.transaction_amount) AS total_amount
    FROM Customers_Cards cc
    JOIN Financial_Transactions ft ON cc.card_id = ft.card_id
    WHERE cc.card_type_code = 'Credit'
      AND ft.transaction_date >= datetime('now', '-12 months')
    GROUP BY cc.card_id, cc.customer_id
    HAVING total_amount > 10000
)
SELECT
    c.customer_first_name || ' ' || c.customer_last_name AS full_name,
    c.customer_email,
    cs.card_id
FROM CardSums cs
JOIN Customers c ON cs.customer_id = c.customer_id;

SELECT DISTINCT
    c.customer_first_name || ' ' || c.customer_last_name AS customer_full_name,
    c.customer_email,
    cc.card_id
FROM Customers c
INNER JOIN Customers_Cards cc ON c.customer_id = cc.customer_id
INNER JOIN Financial_Transactions ft ON cc.card_id = ft.card_id
WHERE cc.card_type_code = 'Credit'
GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_first_name, c.customer_last_name, c.customer_email, cc.card_id
HAVING SUM(COALESCE(ft.transaction_amount, 0)) > 0

SELECT DISTINCT c.customer_first_name,
                c.customer_last_name,
                a.account_name
FROM Customers AS c
JOIN Accounts AS a ON c.customer_id = a.customer_id
JOIN Customers_Cards AS cc ON c.customer_id = cc.customer_id
   AND cc.card_type_code = 'Credit'
JOIN Financial_Transactions AS ft ON ft.account_id = a.account_id
    AND ft.card_id = cc.card_id
GROUP BY c.customer_id, a.account_id
HAVING COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ft.transaction_type = 'Payment' THEN ft.transaction_amount END),0) >
       COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ft.transaction_type = 'Refund' THEN ft.transaction_amount END),0);

    c.customer_first_name,
    c.customer_last_name,
    a.account_name,
    a.other_account_details
FROM Customers c
JOIN Accounts a ON c.customer_id = a.customer_id
JOIN Financial_Transactions ft ON a.account_id = ft.account_id
WHERE ft.transaction_amount > 1000
AND ft.transaction_type != 'Refund'

WITH customer_tx AS (
    SELECT c.customer_id,
           SUM(ft.transaction_amount) AS total_amount
    FROM "Customers" c
    JOIN "Accounts" a ON a.customer_id = c.customer_id
    JOIN "Financial_Transactions" ft ON ft.account_id = a.account_id
    GROUP BY c.customer_id
),
avg_tx AS (
    SELECT AVG(total_amount) AS avg_total
    FROM customer_tx
)
SELECT c.customer_first_name,
       c.customer_last_name,
       a.account_name,
       a.other_account_details
FROM "Customers" c
JOIN "Accounts" a ON a.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN customer_tx ct ON ct.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN avg_tx at ON 1=1
WHERE ct.total_amount > at.avg_total;

WITH daily_sums AS (
    SELECT
        ft.card_id,
        date(ft.transaction_date) AS txn_date,
        SUM(ft.transaction_amount) AS daily_total
    FROM Financial_Transactions ft
    GROUP BY ft.card_id, date(ft.transaction_date)
)
SELECT
    c.customer_first_name || ' ' || c.customer_last_name AS full_name,
    cc.card_type_code AS card_type,
    ds.txn_date AS transaction_date,
    ds.daily_total,
    CASE cc.card_type_code
        WHEN 'Credit' THEN 2000
        WHEN 'Debit'  THEN 1000
        ELSE 1500
    END AS applicable_limit,
    ds.daily_total - CASE cc.card_type_code
        WHEN 'Credit' THEN 2000
        WHEN 'Debit'  THEN 1000
        ELSE 1500
    END AS excess_amount
FROM daily_sums ds
JOIN Customers_Cards cc ON ds.card_id = cc.card_id
JOIN Customers c ON cc.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE ds.daily_total > CASE cc.card_type_code
        WHEN 'Credit' THEN 2000
        WHEN 'Debit'  THEN 1000
        ELSE 1500
    END
ORDER BY full_name, transaction_date;

votes.sql:
SELECT c.customer_first_name,
       c.customer_last_name,
       CASE
         WHEN s.total_spent >= 5000 THEN 'Gold'
         WHEN s.total_spent >= 2000 THEN 'Silver'
         ELSE 'Bronze'
       END AS tier
FROM (
    SELECT a.customer_id,
           COALESCE(SUM(ft.transaction_amount), 0) AS total_spent
    FROM Accounts a
    LEFT JOIN Financial_Transactions ft
           ON ft.account_id = a.account_id
          AND ft.transaction_type = 'Payment'
    GROUP BY a.customer_id
) s
JOIN Customers c ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id
ORDER BY tier DESC, s.total_spent DESC;

SELECT 
    c.customer_first_name || ' ' || c.customer_last_name AS customer_name,
    CASE 
        WHEN SUM(ft.transaction_amount) >= 5000 THEN 'Gold'
        WHEN SUM(ft.transaction_amount) >= 2000 THEN 'Silver'
        ELSE 'Bronze'
    END AS member_tier
FROM Financial_Transactions ft
JOIN Accounts a ON ft.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN Customers c ON a.customer_id = c.customer_id
GROUP BY c.customer_id
ORDER BY customer_name;

WITH customer_spend AS (
  SELECT
    c.customer_id,
    c.customer_first_name,
    c.customer_last_name,
    SUM(ft.transaction_amount) AS total_spent
  FROM Financial_Transactions ft
  JOIN Accounts a ON ft.account_id = a.account_id
  JOIN Customers c ON a.customer_id = c.customer_id
  GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_first_name, c.customer_last_name
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    customer_id,
    customer_first_name,
    customer_last_name,
    total_spent,
    NTILE(3) OVER (ORDER BY total_spent DESC) AS tile
  FROM customer_spend
)
SELECT
  customer_first_name || ' ' || customer_last_name AS customer_name,
  CASE
    WHEN tile = 1 THEN 'Gold'
    WHEN tile = 2 THEN 'Silver'
    ELSE 'Bronze'
  END AS membership_tier
FROM ranked
ORDER BY membership_tier, customer_name;

SELECT c.customer_first_name,
       c.customer_last_name,
       a.account_id
FROM Customers c
JOIN Accounts a ON a.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN Financial_Transactions ft ON ft.account_id = a.account_id
GROUP BY c.customer_first_name, c.customer_last_name, a.account_id
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN ft.transaction_type = 'Payment' THEN ft.transaction_amount
                 WHEN ft.transaction_type = 'Refund' THEN -ft.transaction_amount
                 ELSE 0 END) > 0
ORDER BY SUM(CASE WHEN ft.transaction_type = 'Payment' THEN ft.transaction_amount
                 WHEN ft.transaction_type = 'Refund' THEN -ft.transaction_amount
                 ELSE 0 END) DESC;

SELECT c.customer_first_name, c.customer_last_name, a.account_id
FROM Customers c
JOIN Accounts a ON c.customer_id = a.customer_id
JOIN Financial_Transactions ft ON a.account_id = ft.account_id
GROUP BY c.customer_id, a.account_id
ORDER BY SUM(ft.transaction_amount) DESC;

votes.sql:
WITH customer_net AS (
    SELECT
        cc.customer_id,
        COALESCE(SUM(
            CASE
                WHEN ft.transaction_type = 'Payment' THEN ft.transaction_amount
                WHEN ft.transaction_type = 'Refund' THEN -ft.transaction_amount
                ELSE 0
            END
        ), 0) AS net_amount
    FROM Financial_Transactions ft
    JOIN Customers_Cards cc ON ft.card_id = cc.card_id
    WHERE ft.transaction_date >= date('now','-12 months')
    GROUP BY cc.customer_id
)
SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN cn.net_amount >= 5000 THEN 'Excellent'
        WHEN cn.net_amount >= 2000 THEN 'Good'
        WHEN cn.net_amount >= 0    THEN 'Fair'
        ELSE 'Poor'
    END AS tier,
    c.customer_first_name || ' ' || c.customer_last_name AS full_name,
    cn.net_amount
FROM customer_net cn
JOIN Customers c ON cn.customer_id = c.customer_id
ORDER BY
    CASE
        WHEN cn.net_amount >= 5000 THEN 1
        WHEN cn.net_amount >= 2000 THEN 2
        WHEN cn.net_amount >= 0    THEN 3
        ELSE 4
    END,
    cn.net_amount DESC;

WITH CustomerNetAmount AS (
    SELECT 
        c.customer_id,
        c.customer_first_name || ' ' || c.customer_last_name AS full_name,
        SUM(CASE WHEN ft.transaction_type = 'Payment' THEN ft.transaction_amount ELSE 0 END) -
        SUM(CASE WHEN ft.transaction_type = 'Refund' THEN ft.transaction_amount ELSE 0 END) AS net_amount
    FROM Customers c
    JOIN Accounts a ON c.customer_id = a.customer_id
    JOIN Financial_Transactions ft ON a.account_id = ft.account_id
    WHERE ft.transaction_date >= datetime('now', '-12 months')
    GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_first_name, c.customer_last_name
)
SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN net_amount >= 5000 THEN 'Excellent'
        WHEN net_amount >= 2000 THEN 'Good'
        WHEN net_amount >= 500 THEN 'Fair'
        ELSE 'Poor'
    END AS tier,
    full_name,
    net_amount
FROM CustomerNetAmount
ORDER BY 
    CASE 
        WHEN net_amount >= 5000 THEN 1
        WHEN net_amount >= 2000 THEN 2
        WHEN net_amount >= 500 THEN 3
        ELSE 4
    END,
    net_amount DESC

WITH max_dt AS (SELECT MAX(transaction_date) AS max_transaction_date FROM Financial_Transactions),
     recent_tx AS (
         SELECT ft.account_id,
                ft.card_id,
                CASE WHEN ft.transaction_type = 'Payment' THEN ft.transaction_amount ELSE 0 END AS payment_amt,
                CASE WHEN ft.transaction_type = 'Refund' THEN ft.transaction_amount ELSE 0 END AS refund_amt
         FROM Financial_Transactions ft
         JOIN max_dt md ON 1=1
         WHERE ft.transaction_date >= datetime(md.max_transaction_date, '-12 months')
     ),
     cust_net AS (
         SELECT a.customer_id,
                SUM(rt.payment_amt) - SUM(rt.refund_amt) AS net_amount
         FROM recent_tx rt
         JOIN Accounts a ON rt.account_id = a.account_id
         GROUP BY a.customer_id
     ),
     cust_info AS (
         SELECT c.customer_id,
                c.customer_first_name || ' ' || c.customer_last_name AS full_name,
                cn.net_amount
         FROM Customers c
         JOIN cust_net cn ON c.customer_id = cn.customer_id
     ),
     tiered AS (
         SELECT full_name,
                net_amount,
                NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY net_amount DESC) AS tile
         FROM cust_info
     )
     SELECT CASE tile
                WHEN 1 THEN 'Excellent'
                WHEN 2 THEN 'Good'
                WHEN 3 THEN 'Fair'
                WHEN 4 THEN 'Poor'
            END AS tier,
            full_name,
            net_amount
     FROM tiered
     ORDER BY
         CASE tile
             WHEN 1 THEN 1
             WHEN 2 THEN 2
             WHEN 3 THEN 3
             WHEN 4 THEN 4
         END,
         net_amount DESC;

WITH monthly_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        c.customer_id,
        c.customer_first_name,
        c.customer_last_name,
        strftime('%Y-%m', ft.transaction_date) AS transaction_month,
        SUM(ft.transaction_amount) AS monthly_total
    FROM Customers c
    JOIN Accounts a ON c.customer_id = a.customer_id
    JOIN Financial_Transactions ft ON a.account_id = ft.account_id
    GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_first_name, c.customer_last_name, strftime('%Y-%m', ft.transaction_date)
),
monthly_with_prev AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        customer_first_name,
        customer_last_name,
        transaction_month,
        monthly_total,
        LAG(monthly_total) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY transaction_month) AS prev_total,
        LAG(transaction_month) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY transaction_month) AS prev_month
    FROM monthly_totals
),
monthly_growth AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        customer_first_name,
        customer_last_name,
        transaction_month,
        monthly_total,
        prev_total,
        prev_month,
        CASE 
            WHEN prev_total IS NOT NULL AND prev_total > 0 THEN (monthly_total - prev_total) * 100.0 / prev_total
            ELSE 0
        END AS pct_change,
        CASE 
            WHEN prev_total IS NOT NULL AND prev_total > 0 AND (monthly_total - prev_total) * 100.0 / prev_total >= 10.0 THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END AS meets_threshold,
        CASE 
            WHEN prev_month IS NOT NULL THEN 
                CAST(strftime('%m', date(transaction_month || '-01')) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%m', date(prev_month || '-01')) AS INTEGER)
            ELSE 0
        END AS month_diff
    FROM monthly_with_prev
),
streak_segment AS (
    SELECT 
        *,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY transaction_month) AS rn
    FROM monthly_growth
),
streak_groups AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        customer_first_name,
        customer_last_name,
        transaction_month,
        pct_change,
        meets_threshold,
        rn - ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id, meets_threshold ORDER BY transaction_month) AS grp
    FROM streak_segment
    WHERE meets_threshold = 1
),
streak_summary AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        customer_first_name,
        customer_last_name,
        grp,
        COUNT(*) AS streak_length,
        MIN(transaction_month) AS streak_start_month
    FROM streak_groups
    GROUP BY customer_id, customer_first_name, customer_last_name, grp
    HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3
)
SELECT DISTINCT
    customer_first_name || ' ' || customer_last_name AS customer_name,
    streak_start_month AS streak_start_month
FROM streak_summary
ORDER BY customer_name, streak_start_month;

WITH monthly AS (
    SELECT
        c.customer_id,
        c.customer_first_name,
        c.customer_last_name,
        strftime('%Y-%m', ft.transaction_date) AS yr_month,
        SUM(ft.transaction_amount) AS total_amount
    FROM Financial_Transactions ft
    JOIN Accounts a ON ft.account_id = a.account_id
    JOIN Customers c ON a.customer_id = c.customer_id
    GROUP BY c.customer_id, yr_month
),
flagged AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        customer_first_name,
        customer_last_name,
        yr_month,
        total_amount,
        LAG(total_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY yr_month) AS prev_total,
        CASE
            WHEN LAG(total_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY yr_month) IS NOT NULL
                 AND total_amount >= LAG(total_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY yr_month) * 1.10
            THEN 1 ELSE 0
        END AS inc_flag
    FROM monthly
),
grp AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        customer_first_name,
        customer_last_name,
        yr_month,
        inc_flag,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY yr_month) -
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id, inc_flag ORDER BY yr_month) AS grp_id
    FROM flagged
)
SELECT
    customer_first_name,
    customer_last_name,
    MIN(yr_month) AS start_month
FROM grp
WHERE inc_flag = 1
GROUP BY customer_id, grp_id, customer_first_name, customer_last_name
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2;

votes.sql:
WITH customer_baseline AS (
    SELECT a.customer_id,
           AVG(ft.transaction_amount) AS avg_amount
    FROM Financial_Transactions ft
    JOIN Accounts a ON ft.account_id = a.account_id
    WHERE ft.transaction_date >= date('now', '-6 months')
    GROUP BY a.customer_id
)
SELECT ft.transaction_id
FROM Financial_Transactions ft
JOIN Accounts a ON ft.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN customer_baseline cb ON a.customer_id = cb.customer_id
WHERE ft.transaction_amount > cb.avg_amount;

WITH customer_baseline AS (
    SELECT 
        a.customer_id,
        AVG(ft.transaction_amount) AS avg_spending
    FROM Financial_Transactions ft
    JOIN Accounts a ON ft.account_id = a.account_id
    WHERE ft.transaction_amount IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY a.customer_id
)
SELECT 
    ft.transaction_id,
    ft.transaction_amount,
    cb.avg_spending,
    ft.transaction_date,
    ft.transaction_comment
FROM Financial_Transactions ft
JOIN Accounts a ON ft.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN customer_baseline cb ON a.customer_id = cb.customer_id
WHERE ft.transaction_amount > cb.avg_spending * 2
AND ft.transaction_amount IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY ft.transaction_amount DESC;

WITH cust_tx AS (
    SELECT ft.transaction_id,
           ft.transaction_amount,
           ft.transaction_date,
           cc.customer_id
    FROM Financial_Transactions ft
    JOIN Customers_Cards cc ON ft.card_id = cc.card_id
),
baseline AS (
    SELECT ct.transaction_id,
           ct.transaction_amount,
           ct.transaction_date,
           ct.customer_id,
           (SELECT AVG(inner_ct.transaction_amount)
            FROM cust_tx inner_ct
            WHERE inner_ct.customer_id = ct.customer_id
              AND inner_ct.transaction_date >= datetime(ct.transaction_date, '-6 months')
              AND inner_ct.transaction_date < ct.transaction_date
           ) AS six_month_avg
    FROM cust_tx ct
)
SELECT transaction_id
FROM baseline
WHERE transaction_amount > six_month_avg
  AND six_month_avg IS NOT NULL;
}

votes.sql:
WITH cust_spending AS (
    SELECT a.customer_id,
           strftime('%Y', ft.transaction_date) AS yr,
           SUM(CASE WHEN ft.transaction_type = 'Payment' THEN ft.transaction_amount
                    WHEN ft.transaction_type = 'Refund' THEN -ft.transaction_amount
                    ELSE 0 END) AS annual_spending,
           COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS account_cnt
    FROM Financial_Transactions ft
    JOIN Accounts a ON ft.account_id = a.account_id
    GROUP BY a.customer_id, yr
),
avg_spending AS (
    SELECT yr, AVG(annual_spending) AS avg_spending
    FROM cust_spending
    GROUP BY yr
)
SELECT c.customer_first_name, c.customer_last_name
FROM cust_spending cs
JOIN avg_spending av ON cs.yr = av.yr
JOIN Customers c ON cs.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE cs.annual_spending > av.avg_spending
  AND cs.account_cnt > 1;

SELECT DISTINCT
    c.customer_first_name,
    c.customer_last_name
FROM Customers c
INNER JOIN Accounts a ON c.customer_id = a.customer_id
WHERE a.account_name = 'VIP'

WITH vip_customers AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT customer_id
  FROM Accounts
  WHERE account_name = 'VIP'
),
yearly_spending AS (
  SELECT c.customer_id,
         strftime('%Y', ft.transaction_date) AS year,
         SUM(ft.transaction_amount) AS total_spent
  FROM Customers c
  JOIN Accounts a ON a.customer_id = c.customer_id
  JOIN Financial_Transactions ft ON ft.account_id = a.account_id
  GROUP BY c.customer_id, year
),
avg_spending AS (
  SELECT year, AVG(total_spent) AS avg_spent
  FROM yearly_spending
  GROUP BY year
)
SELECT DISTINCT cu.customer_first_name,
                cu.customer_last_name
FROM yearly_spending ys
JOIN avg_spending av ON ys.year = av.year
JOIN vip_customers vc ON ys.customer_id = vc.customer_id
JOIN Customers cu ON ys.customer_id = cu.customer_id
WHERE ys.total_spent > av.avg_spent;

votes.sql:
WITH refunds AS (
    SELECT
        ft.transaction_id,
        cc.customer_id,
        ft.transaction_date,
        ft.transaction_amount,
        SUM(ft.transaction_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY cc.customer_id ORDER BY ft.transaction_date ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS running_total
    FROM Financial_Transactions ft
    JOIN Customers_Cards cc ON ft.card_id = cc.card_id
    WHERE ft.transaction_type = 'Refund'
),
customer_max AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        MAX(running_total) AS max_running_total
    FROM refunds
    GROUP BY customer_id
),
pct90 AS (
    SELECT
        MAX(max_running_total) AS value
    FROM (
        SELECT max_running_total
        FROM customer_max
        ORDER BY max_running_total
        LIMIT 1 OFFSET (SELECT CAST(COUNT(*) * 0.9 AS INTEGER) FROM customer_max)
    )
)
SELECT
    r.customer_id,
    r.transaction_date,
    r.running_total
FROM refunds r
JOIN customer_max cm ON r.customer_id = cm.customer_id
WHERE cm.max_running_total > (SELECT value FROM pct90)
ORDER BY r.customer_id, r.transaction_date;

WITH REFUND_DATA AS (
    SELECT 
        ac.customer_id,
        ft.transaction_date,
        ft.transaction_amount
    FROM Financial_Transactions ft
    INNER JOIN Accounts ac ON ft.account_id = ac.account_id
    WHERE ft.transaction_type = 'Refund'
),
RUNNING_TOTALS AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        transaction_date,
        SUM(transaction_amount) OVER (
            PARTITION BY customer_id 
            ORDER BY transaction_date
            ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
        ) AS running_total
    FROM REFUND_DATA
),
CUSTOMER_MAXES AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        MAX(running_total) AS max_running_total
    FROM RUNNING_TOTALS
    GROUP BY customer_id
),
PERCENTILE_THRESHOLD AS (
    SELECT 
        (MAX(max_running_total) + MIN(max_running_total)) / 2.0 AS percentile_90
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            max_running_total,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY max_running_total DESC) AS rn,
            COUNT(*) OVER () AS total_count
        FROM CUSTOMER_MAXES
    ) ranked
    WHERE rn = CAST(total_count * 0.9 AS INTEGER)
)
SELECT DISTINCT rt.customer_id
FROM RUNNING_TOTALS rt
CROSS JOIN PERCENTILE_THRESHOLD pt
WHERE rt.running_total > pt.percentile_90;

WITH refunds AS (
    SELECT
        c.customer_id,
        ft.transaction_date,
        ft.transaction_amount AS amount_usd
    FROM "Financial_Transactions" ft
    JOIN "Accounts" a ON ft.account_id = a.account_id
    JOIN "Customers" c ON a.customer_id = c.customer_id
    WHERE ft.transaction_type = 'Refund'
),
eur AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        transaction_date,
        amount_usd AS amount_eur  -- Assuming EUR/USD rate = 1 (no exchange rate table available)
    FROM refunds
),
running AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        transaction_date,
        SUM(amount_eur) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY transaction_date
                              ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS running_total
    FROM eur
),
max_running AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        MAX(running_total) AS max_running_total
    FROM running
    GROUP BY customer_id
),
p90 AS (
    SELECT
        max_running_total AS p90_value
    FROM (
        SELECT
            max_running_total,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY max_running_total) AS rn,
            COUNT(*) OVER () AS cnt
        FROM max_running
    )
    WHERE rn = CAST(CEIL(0.9 * cnt) AS INTEGER)
)
SELECT
    mr.customer_id,
    mr.max_running_total AS running_total
FROM max_running mr
JOIN p90 p ON 1=1
WHERE mr.max_running_total > p.p90_value;
